csv_and_quote_policy: November daily volatility CSVs ended on 11 November at retrieval; the frozen 12 November Cboe quotes supply the final input. The archived overlap is retained.
training_rule: For each close t, use the latest 1,260 finite pairs with target_date <= t. Construct the target on the actual equity-session calendar with a six-row shift.
historical_availability: Final daily values are treated as usable by the next equity session London noon. Original release/correction vintages have not been fully verified.
other_factors: Option statistics and Treasury yields follow the conservative lag rules recorded in factor_catalog.csv. features100.csv.gz is the frozen derived matrix, not a new retrieval.
